record.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Understanding the generalization capabilities of visuomotor policies is essential in the development of capable robotic agents. Generalizable models learn structures that transfer across domains. However, in practice, visuomotor policies test performance by interpolation on known distributions using unstructured domain shifts (e.g. lighting, clutter, diverse objects). We argue … This is a application/model-method paper for forecasting, image generation, robotics, telemetry, or image compression rather than LLM inference/serving efficiency.
record.title: Inductive Generalization for Robotic Manipulation
